component.name: Google Photos Upload
component.summary: Tray flyout for uploading selected folders to Google Photos

description.p: Problem: Uploading photo and video folders from Ubuntu to Google Photos is awkward when each folder belongs in a specific album. Command-line uploads make it hard to see what is finished, whether Google is still processing a batch, when the daily quota will reset, or how to stop one source without losing track of the rest.

Solution: Google Photos Upload puts the upload workflow in one system-tray flyout. Map selected folders to Google Photos albums, track progress and transfer speed, monitor quota state, and pause, resume, cancel, or retry individual sources. It uploads through rclone and keeps credentials and source configuration under your control. Built by BinaryPlates (Mohammad Mustafa) for Ubuntu desktops.
